ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a fish with multiple letter labels pointing to different body parts and fins. Along the top/back of the fish there are two dorsal fins: a larger front dorsal fin with prominent spines labeled D, and a smaller rear upper fin with softer rays. The leader line from the letter F points to this smaller rear upper dorsal fin. Reasoning: The question asks for the label of the Soft Dorsal. The soft dorsal is the rear dorsal fin on the top of the fish, behind the spiny dorsal fin. In the image, that rear upper fin is labeled F.
